thread:
harper: Heads up folks  new kombucha keg installed in the fridge. Please use the labeled tap pitcher, not the filter carafe. :tropical_drink:

jos: glorious news. who is responsible for returning the empty growlers to the shop?

ana: (that's me) i'll bring the first empty back tomorrow AM. also FYI the cookie tin by the sink contains peanut cookies again  please label allergens.

harper: oh no, allergy reminder posted a few weeks ago. can we make a hard rule: NO PEANUTS in shared tins?

ops-bot: Policy reminder: shared_kitchen_allergens_rule=NO_PEANUTS_IN_SHARED_TIN. Flagging channel #people-ops for redistribution of allergy cards. Inventory snapshot: kombucha_keg=1_full, oat_milk=2_cartons, sugar=0.3kg, stirrers=6.

jos: +1 on rule. also can someone order a small allergen card set and a tiny label maker? tiny labels would save lives and dignity.

ken: i can order a label maker today. any brand preference? battery or USB?

samir: USB please. batteries always die mid-label. :grimacing:

ana: whoever runs snacks this week  can we do vegan cookies and a savory option? saves the peanut drama.

harper: vote: vegan chocolate chip + mini savory empanadas. also we need sugar for the kombucha keg priming (ops-bot says low).

ops-bot: Action created: purchase_label_maker (assignee=ken), purchase_sugar (assignee=harper). Reminder: returnable_growler_pickup assigned to ana for tomorrow.

ken: ordered labeler: Brother PT-P710BT. ETA 3 days. I'll post the receipt.

samir: can we start a weekly snack rota? volunteer calendar slot looks empty past Thursday. i'll take Wednesdays for the next month.

harper: amazing, rota would help. i'll add a shared doc and a recurring calendar invite.

jos: receipt posted: https://imgur.com/kombucharun226543 (total $24.80 incl tax). harper pls confirm for sugar and i'll send $12.40.

harper: confirmed. Venmo request sent. thanks everyone. please label your personal jars.

ana: tiny PSA: someone used the steel milk frother as a whisk and left it in the sink. not a big deal but please don't.

samir: noted. also proposing honorary title for the rota lead: "Kombucha & Cookie Czar". nominations open. :crown:

ken: i nominate samir. he's doing Wednesdays. :raised_hands:

samir: accepting with humility and a pastry-fueled heart. planning first official combo tasting Wednesday morning. pictures required. :camera_with_flash:

harper: brilliant. last thing  could we add a small sign by the tin: "If unlabeled, it's NOT shared"? prevents future mystery munching.

ops-bot: Sign request created: sign_unlabeled_not_shared. Assigned to ken. ETA 48 hours.

jos: love this. peace, labels, and kombucha. :sparkles:
